item.title: TideGrab 0.9.1
item.description:
Open pages that need more

  • Open Page in TideGrab: when a link needs a sign-in or a site can't be read, open the page in TideGrab, sign in if it asks, press play, and add what it plays.
  • Sign-ins are kept per site inside TideGrab and sent only to that site. Settings › Browser lists them and signs out.

Convert saved files

  • Convert… to MP4 (H.264 or HEVC, HDR kept), ProRes, GIF, M4A, MP3, FLAC or WAV, with size, quality and an optional part.
  • TideGrab says what converting costs before it starts, and points to the copy without re-encoding when that gives the same result.
  • Save Audio As MP3, M4A, FLAC or WAV. Downloads can also save audio as FLAC or WAV.
  • Frame previews and trimming for every format, WebM and MKV included.

Better names

  • Links queued together get their real titles and thumbnails.
  • File names read naturally: "Film: Part 2" saves as "Film - Part 2".

TideGrab Pro

  • Lists and playlists, several downloads at once, Convert, live recording, Follow, Shortcuts, the browser extension and media-library names are TideGrab Pro (€19.99 once). Until Pro goes on sale, all of it is included.

Updates

  • TideGrab now updates itself. Settings › Updates checks once a day and installs signed updates when you quit.

Changes

  • "Use my browser's sign-in" and the aria2 option are gone; Open Page replaces the first.
  • Sites that block download tools (such as Rumble and Bilibili) now say so plainly.
  • The list view's selected row and the shortcut hints are easier to read.
  • The window no longer scrolls: a long playlist's list makes room, and only the queue scrolls.
  • The browser extension ships inside the app: Browser Extension… › Show Extension Folder.
